With 125 leads at an $11.46 CPL over 28 days and no active Google Ads spend, scaling Meta or activating Google Ads could be a strong next lever.

performance.verdict: Efficiency gain is real, but spend compression and 3 overdue SOW blockers threaten August scoreboard.

findings.text: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) still open — leads arriving but cannot be traced to calls, breaking the patient-to-revenue scoreboard.
Sync items + contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) still open — 258 GHL contacts but 0 appointments logged; pipeline integrity unverifiable.
CPL improved 38.44% week-over-week to roughly $7.00/lead, but spend fell 40.43% to $35.95/day — efficiency gain is budget compression, not campaign lift.
3-day lead signal (Aug 16–18: 3+8+5=16) vs prior 3 days (Aug 13–15: 4+1+1=6) shows a sharp recovery, but spend also rose from ~$21–$42 to $34–$41 — volume follows dollars, not creative improvement.
GHL shows 83 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments — 125 leads over 28 days are not converting into booked visits; intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Close phone-match attribution gap immediately — without it, zero August leads can be traced to chair revenue.
suggestions.monday_update: The phone-match attribution gap flagged for 2026-08-07 remains open as of 2026-08-19. Without this fix, none of the 125 leads in the 28-day window can be tied to scheduled or showed appointments, making the August scoreboard unmeasurable for the client. Action: Attribution team completes phone-match mapping this week and confirms in Monday. Success check: at least 1 attributed inbound call visible in GHL by 2026-08-22.

suggestions.text: Repair GHL intake pipeline — 83 opps created, 0 appointments booked; leads are arriving but not converting inside CRM.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 83 opportunities created and 0 appointments over 28 days against 125 Meta leads — this is an intake workflow gap, not an ads problem. The sync + contact cleanup milestone (due 2026-08-14) remains open and likely contributes. Action: Ahmed/Ali audit the opportunity-to-appointment stage, confirm Flex Dental handoff is functioning, and complete the contact cleanup. Success check: at least 5 appointments visible in GHL by 2026-08-26.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta spend recovery — if daily spend holds above $40 and CPL stays below $12 for 3 consecutive days, a +15% budget increase is defensible.
suggestions.monday_update: Spend compressed to $35.95/day average this week, masking the true CPL floor. The 3-day lead recovery (16 leads Aug 16–18 vs 6 leads Aug 13–15) is encouraging but tracks spend, not creative efficiency. Re-check on 2026-08-22: if spend is above $40/day and CPL is below $12 for 3 full days, Sohib may approve a +15% daily budget increase on BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness. Do not scale before attribution (S1) and intake (S2) are verified — more leads into a broken pipeline does not serve the August scoreboard.
